text:
Anya Chen: CI job 'goldens/prompt-render' failed on main — looks like a tiny serialization change. failing diff shows an extra escaped quote in the prompt output.

Anya Chen: snippet: ```expected: "Generate a summary"
actual: "\"Generate a summary\""
```

Samir Patel: :eyes: can you paste the failing assertion? which test file?

Anya Chen: it's in tests/goldens/prompt_renderer/test_prompts.py::test_system_prompt_roundtrip — assertion compares raw serialized prompt string.

Samir Patel: ok. quick attempt: can you rerun the job first to see if it's flaky? I can trigger a rerun on Buildkite.

Anya Chen: trying rerun now — ci-bot kicked off build 9912.

CI Bot: Build 9912 started (re-run of 9908) — https://ci.example.com/builds/9912 :rocket:

Julia Gomez: if rerun is green then likely flake, if still red we should bisect. could be that recent PR that touched encoder/escape logic changed behavior.

David R: small tip: for local repro run `pytest tests/goldens/prompt_renderer -k roundtrip -q` and to regenerate goldens use `pytest --update-goldens` (we added that flag in tools/golden_helper).

Samir Patel: if you want a quick bisect, try `git bisect start HEAD origin/main~30` then `git bisect run ./scripts/test-golden-ci.sh tests/goldens/prompt_renderer` — our bisect script exits 0/1 for pass/fail.

Anya Chen: rerun result: still red on 9912. attaching full diff: ```--- expected
+++ actual
@@
-Generate a summary
+"Generate a summary"
```

Julia Gomez: that looks like accidental double-escaping when dumping prompt meta. maybe `json.dumps()` called twice or a change in the logging formatter. any PRs touching prompt_serializer in the past week?

David R: I glanced at PR #4297 — it reformatted how we build prompt blobs (small perf change). @Samir any idea?

Samir Patel: yep PR 4297 touched prompt_serializer.encode -> switched to using ujson under a feature flag. if ujson handles quotes differently that could explain it. can we toggle flag and rerun?

Anya Chen: feature flag is `USE_UJSON_FOR_PROMPT` in env. I'll spin a quick job with it off. starting build 9915 with flag disabled.

CI Bot: Build 9915 started (env override USE_UJSON_FOR_PROMPT=false) — https://ci.example.com/builds/9915

Samir Patel: good — if 9915 passes, root cause identified. if it stays red, we bisect.

Anya Chen: 9915 is green! :tada: so ujson change is the culprit.

Julia Gomez: nice. next steps: revert or add escaping normalization in serializer. we should also add a golden test that asserts serialization idempotence (dump(load(dump(x))) equals dump(x)).

David R: I'll open a quick revert PR to flip the flag off by default and add a TODO to re-evaluate ujson differences. Samir can follow up with a proper fix to make outputs stable.

Samir Patel: sounds good. I'll also update the golden helper docs with the local repro steps so folks can quickly run the regen.

Anya Chen: thanks everyone — leaving notes on the failing build and marking the issue as root-cause ujson-escape. :white_check_mark:

Julia Gomez: follow-up action items: 1) David: revert flag PR (small) 2) Samir: investigation + fix for escaping 3) Anya: close CI incident and add comment to original failing PR.

David R: on it. tagging owners in the revert PR.
